backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Trade, ManagedAccount, PerformanceMetrics, and UserProfile types with full CRUD operations, access-control authorization via mixins, and hardcoded initial performance state (totalCapital = 327.0).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three high-confidence features: updating Winning Trades to 3, Total Trades to 3, and Total P&L to $108.7 in the HomePage.tsx stats section, each mapped to specific XPaths and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, utilities, and layout files across the React application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, etc.) for both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting the page title to 'Quarterly FXelangbam algo' and mounting the React root via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that configures TanStack Router with public and admin route trees, wraps everything in ThemeProvider and SiteWideGate authentication guard, and includes a global Toaster.
Admin layout wrapper rendering a header with the dashboard title, 'Quarterly FXelangbam algo' subtitle, and a logout button (visible only to admins) alongside a main content area.
frontend/src/components/app/AppHeader.ts: Shared site header component rendering a linked wordmark image with alt text 'Quarterly FXelangbam algo' using a capitalized FX asset.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicFooter: Footer component displaying a trading risk disclaimer and a 2026 copyright notice, with no external attributions.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicLayout: Public page layout providing a background texture overlay, AppHeader, sticky navigation links (Home, Portfolio, Managed Accounts, Analytics), a main content slot, and PublicFooter.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/A: A dialog component for adding or editing a managed account, with form fields for name, balance, and risk profile, using mutation hooks to persist changes.
A card-based table component that lists all managed accounts with options to add, edit, or delete each account, delegating form interactions to AccountFormDialog.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/C: A panel component that accepts a CSV file upload, validates and previews parsed trades, then bulk-imports valid trades via the addTrade mutation hook.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/M: A card component that loads current performance metrics into a form and allows admins to update fields like total P&L, ROI, and drawdown via the updateMetrics mutation.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/T: A dialog component for adding or editing a trade record, with fields for symbol, direction, prices, quantity, and P&L, using add/update trade mutation hooks.
Renders an admin table for managing trades with add, edit, and delete actions, using query data and mutation hooks with toast notifications.
frontend/src/features/admin/hooks/useAdm: Provides React Query mutation hooks for CRUD operations on trades, accounts, and performance metrics via the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/admin/pages/AdminD: Admin dashboard page with tabbed navigation for managing trades, accounts, metrics, and CSV imports.
frontend/src/features/admin/utils/csv.ts: Parses and validates CSV text into trade objects, returning arrays of valid trades and row-level validation errors.
frontend/src/features/analytics/componen: Renders an SVG equity curve chart with area fill and grid lines from an array of equity data points.
Renders an SVG bar chart displaying monthly profit and loss values with color-coded positive/negative bars.
Renders an SVG donut chart with a legend showing the win/loss trade distribution and percentages.
frontend/src/features/analytics/pages/Pe: Analytics page that fetches trades and metrics, computes monthly P&L, win/loss, and equity curve data, and renders them in chart cards.
frontend/src/features/analytics/utils/an: Provides utility functions to compute monthly P&L, win/loss counts, and equity curve data from trade and performance metrics arrays.
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Ad: A route guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to the admin login page and shows an access-denied message for non-admin users.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useAdmi: Custom hook that combines Internet Identity authentication state with a canister `isCallerAdmin` query to expose authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/features/auth/pages/AdminLo: Admin login page that triggers Internet Identity login and redirects authenticated admins to the dashboard, showing an error for non-admin accounts.
frontend/src/features/auth/types.ts: Defines TypeScript types for authentication status strings and the overall auth state shape.
frontend/src/features/data/queries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching performance metrics, all trades, and all managed accounts from the backend canister actor.
frontend/src/features/public/components/: Renders a simple SVG area/line chart visualizing simulated account balance growth based on the provided current balance.
Renders month, year, and result filter dropdowns for filtering the trade list, calling a callback on any change.
Displays a paginated table of trades with columns for date, symbol, direction, entry/exit prices, quantity, and color-coded P&L.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/HomeP: Public home page that displays overall trading performance metric cards (total P&L, win rate, total trades, total capital) with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Manag: Displays a grid of managed trading accounts with masked names, balances, risk profiles, and growth charts, fetched via a query hook with skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Portf: Shows a filterable trade history table, allowing users to filter trades by month, year, and profit/loss result using memoized filtering logic.
frontend/src/features/public/utils/maski: Exports a utility function that masks the middle characters of an account name, preserving the first two and last two characters.
frontend/src/features/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Custom hook that sets the document title and meta description tag on mount or when the provided values change.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/GateScree: Renders a login form card with username and password fields, error display, and a submit button for site access gating.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/SiteWideG: Wraps the app in an access gate that shows a login screen until valid credentials are submitted, then renders children and navigates to home on success.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/useSiteGa: Hook that manages site-wide access state using sessionStorage, exposing unlock/lock functions and validating hardcoded credentials.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base/component/utility layers and CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (using oklch), typography, border radius, font families, and accordion animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for a trading stats dashboard app tracking three implemented features: updating Winning Trades, Total Trades, and Total P&L display values in the homepage stats section.
